rootCause.before: out = out.replace(/잠을 충분히 챙기는 자리예요/g, '잠을 충분히 챙기는 하루예요');
rootCause.issue: Unconditional rewrite. Source fragments live in both data/narrative/health_stress/today/brief.fragments.json and data/narrative/health_stress/thisWeek/brief.fragments.json (gating ageBand 10-19, fragmentIds *.youth_10_19.001). Both end with '자리예요'. The unconditional regex rewrites both to '하루예요' (one day), which is a logical contradiction when the period prefix is '이번 주는' (this week).

fix.approach: Replace the single unconditional rewrite with two prefix-anchored rewrites — one per actual data prefix. No 이번 달/올해/평생 handlers added because grep over data/narrative/ confirms those period prefixes do not contain this phrase.
before: out = out.replace(/잠을 충분히 챙기는 자리예요/g, '잠을 충분히 챙기는 하루예요');
after: out = out.replace(/오늘은 잠을 충분히 챙기는 자리예요/g, '오늘은 잠을 충분히 챙기는 하루예요');
out = out.replace(/이번 주는 잠을 충분히 챙기는 자리예요/g, '이번 주는 잠을 충분히 챙기는 한 주예요');
designNotes: Prefix anchoring eliminates ordering hazards with other rules in normalizeRenderedText.
today → 하루예요 preserves the single-day semantic (a day's rest).
thisWeek → 한 주예요 matches the week-period semantic (a week of rest).
Mathematical invariant: each period × phrase pair maps to exactly one period-coherent unit. The mapping is now total and injective on the data-confirmed domain {today, thisWeek}.
Pre-existing fail in tiered-progressive-disclosure (한자/대운궁실 결과 issue) is unrelated and exists before this change.

dataScopeProof.conclusion: Only today and thisWeek prefixes exist for this phrase. No 이번 달/올해/평생 fragments require handlers.
